profile.headline: Software Engineer at BlackRock
profile.summary:
Passionate about performance and scalability to create a resilient application to provide to our end user. Being an SRE given me a new insight for understanding the overall application flow of the company and make enhancements to improve performance and reduce overhead cost. 

Ever since starting this journey into Computer Science, I have seen the ability that technology has to changing people's lives and I want to be one of the many people who made it possible. 
 
I strive for being able to provide my community with resources to teach them about Computer Science and how technology has the ability to change lives. As well as being an example to them that someone who was in the same position as them was able to become successful through hard work and dedication.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained an internal orchestration platform to streamline management of cross-functional applications, driving increased operational efficiency and reducing friction between teams.
- Led the integration of Certificate-Based Authentication for secure access to the internal messaging system, eliminating reliance on shared credentials and improving overall security posture.
- Improved platform stability by proactively identifying and resolving critical bugs, leading to a reduction in downtime and enhanced system reliability for internal stakeholders.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
- Automated infrastructure provisioning and deployment on AWS using Terraform, CloudFormation, SaltStack, and Jenkins, significantly reducing manual effort and accelerating deployment cycles.
- Spearheaded the rollout of a compliant Ubuntu 18 image across infrastructure for SOC 2 security audit requirements, aligning with best security practices and strengthening the security posture of the platform.

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description: I am currently a tutor for an Internet Programming class that is being offered here at CSUMB. My responsibilities range from helping students understand difficult concepts to grading. I have had a great time being able to help students understand concepts that might be confusing because we have or will be in a position where we don't know what to do and need help.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Currently, working on creating a development environment that can be used to reduce the time it takes for Python Software Developers to get started. This is done by using technologies such as Vagrant and VirtualBox to allow the creation of virtual machines to be simpler.

positions.title: Peer Lead Team Learning (PLTL) leader
positions.description: Help guide and answer any questions computer science students have with regards to object oriented programming in C++. Also help build and strengthen their problem solving skills and critical thinking abilities by completing a packet filled with information that they have already covered in class. During this time, I help in reinforce the concept covered in class and remove any ambiguity that they might have with regards to Object Oriented Programming.

positions.title: Team Mentor/Leader for Recorder Project
positions.description: My team and I are adding on to an already existing web app the ability to keep track of records being inputted in by the worker. This web app would allow us to reduce the hassle of keeping track of how much of something was used on a certain piece of equipment. This would also allow the manager or the company to get, almost, real time feedback on how much of something they are using.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I was responsible for designing and creating a part of an app that would make sure that we would receive information from a piece of hardware that was placed within a piece of machinery.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description: I was one of many tutors who were tutoring a group of students who were creating android apps using an ide called App Inventor 2. This platform provides students with a simple way of creating app all while learning some of the concepts of problem solving and critical thinking.

volunteerExperiences.description: The mission of LFC is to provide people within the community access to technology whether it is providing them with low cost or free computers as well as providing workshops that teach people about the different components of a computer. During my time here, I will be helping them migrating from one server to another, help refurbish computers, and automate as many steps as possible to make the process of refurbishing computers easier and faster to do.

projects.title: CrimeMapping
projects.description: We created a app during Cal Hacks 2.0 that would allow us to plot the location of where a crime occurred within a a given city. This app used the Google Maps API and the Data.gov API access the crime records for a given city and then to plot them. The next step would be to implement a database within the application that would allow us to save the locations of the crimes.

projects.title: Reaction Time Game
projects.description: This game is designed to stimulate brains as to whether they can count the number of pictures their are. There are 5 preloaded pictures found in the files and when the program runs, it will choose a random number of them. It will then proceed to cut the image in half and will display it in the GUI. The now divided images will be moving around the screen all while the user tries to keep track of how many whole pictures there are. The user is also given a certain amount of time as to give them some pressure.

organizations.name: Heavy Connect
organizations.description: Part of team that is designing software to save farmers money in their weekly diesel cost.
